Calculate the number-average molecular weight Mn using the formula Mn = Σ(Ni × Mi) / Σ(Ni).
The data set consists of four molecular-weight fractions: 56526 g/mol with 96 molecules, 92809 g/mol with 131 molecules, 115856 g/mol with 153 molecules, and 126029 g/mol with 146 molecules.
Compute the numerator as the sum of each molecular weight multiplied by its corresponding molecule count: 96×56526 + 131×92809 + 153×115856 + 146×126029.
Compute the denominator as the sum of all molecule counts: 96 + 131 + 153 + 146.
Divide the numerator by the denominator to obtain Mn in g/mol.
Report the final answer rounded to the nearest whole number in g/mol.
